description: A link to live hotel and rental prices for a place or any town and the given dates and guests (Stay22, showing Booking.com, Expedia, Agoda, Vrbo and others). The person sees prices and books there; this tool returns no prices and books nothing. Stay Cost Brain may earn a commission on bookings.

child_ages.description: Age of each child on check-in, one entry per child (many taxes exempt under-12s, -16s or -18s); omit for none

place.description: A researched place ('Lisbon', 'Algarve', 'Paris') or any town ('Quarteira', 'Funchal', 'Kyoto')

town.description: Town inside the place to search in (e.g. 'Albufeira' in the Algarve); omit for the whole place

name: hotels_link
title: Hotels link
